( Mascara del jugador ACTIVO: aspecto INVERTIDO (tenue, ojos cerrados = "dormido"). )

( muestra al Player original brillante, intacto. AuraA=equipo A, AuraB=equipo B. )

( --- 0b. INTERCAMBIO POR CLIC: activar el personaje pulsado --- )
( El puente JS estampa "Click" en la casilla pulsada. Si ahi hay un durmiente, )
( pasa a ser el Player activo y el activo anterior se duerme del OTRO equipo )
( (identidad inferida). No genera movimiento -> no cuenta turno ni Sokoban. )
[ Click SleepA ] [ Player ] -> [ Click Player ] [ SleepB ]
[ Click SleepB ] [ Player ] -> [ Click Player ] [ SleepA ]
[ Click LeverOff ] -> [ LeverOn ]
[ Click LeverOn ] -> [ LeverOff ]
( --- NOVEDADES: CLIC CAMBALACHERA (swap posicion caja<->jugador) --- )
[ Click CamBox ] [ Player ] -> [ Click Player ] [ CamBox ]
( --- NOVEDADES: PALANCA TRUEQUERA (swap ocupantes de las gemelas) --- )
( guardas: jugador o agente encima -> el clic no hace nada )
[ Click SwapLever ] [ PadA Player ] -> [ SwapLever ] [ PadA Player ]
[ Click SwapLever ] [ PadB Player ] -> [ SwapLever ] [ PadB Player ]
[ Click SwapLever ] [ PadA Ghost ] -> [ SwapLever ] [ PadA Ghost ]

[ Click SwapLever ] [ PadB Clone ] -> [ SwapLever ] [ PadB Clone ]
( caja<->caja: pares enumerados; caja<->hueco: teletransporte )

( --- 2. EMPUJE SOKOBAN CLÁSICO --- )
UP [ UP Player | Crate ] -> [ UP Player | UP Crate ]
DOWN [ DOWN Player | Crate ] -> [ DOWN Player | DOWN Crate ]
LEFT [ LEFT Player | Crate ] -> [ LEFT Player | LEFT Crate ]
RIGHT [ RIGHT Player | Crate ] -> [ RIGHT Player | RIGHT Crate ]

( --- 2z. AGENTES MOVILES: avanzan solo cuando el jugador MUEVE (turn-based) --- )
( Rebote: invierte direccion al tener un obstaculo/muro delante )
RIGHT [ EnemyR | Obstacle ] -> [ EnemyL | Obstacle ]
LEFT  [ EnemyL | Obstacle ] -> [ EnemyR | Obstacle ]
RIGHT [ GhostR | Wall ] -> [ GhostL | Wall ]
LEFT  [ GhostL | Wall ] -> [ GhostR | Wall ]
( Avance: solo si el jugador se esta moviendo este turno )
[ MOVING Player ] [ EnemyR ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ RIGHT EnemyR ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ EnemyL ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ LEFT  EnemyL ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ GhostR ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ RIGHT GhostR ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ GhostL ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ LEFT  GhostL ]
( Clon: se mueve en ESPEJO horizontal del jugador (izq<->der; arriba/abajo igual) )
LEFT  [ > Player ] [ Clone ] -> [ > Player ] [ RIGHT Clone ]
RIGHT [ > Player ] [ Clone ] -> [ > Player ] [ LEFT  Clone ]
UP    [ > Player ] [ Clone ] -> [ > Player ] [ UP    Clone ]
DOWN  [ > Player ] [ Clone ] -> [ > Player ] [ DOWN  Clone ]
( Muerte del jugador al contacto con el enemigo (mismo layer, direccional) )
[ > Player | Enemy ] -> [ | Enemy ] sfx4
[ > Enemy | Player ] -> [ Enemy | ] sfx4

( GUARDIAN: patrulla, rebota en obstaculos, EMPUJA al jugador (no mata) )
RIGHT [ GuardR | Obstacle ] -> [ GuardL | Obstacle ]
LEFT  [ GuardL | Obstacle ] -> [ GuardR | Obstacle ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ GuardR ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ RIGHT GuardR ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ GuardL ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ LEFT  GuardL ]
[ > GuardR | Player ] -> [ > GuardR | > Player ]
[ > GuardL | Player ] -> [ > GuardL | > Player ]

( SABUESO: patrulla, pero si TE VE (misma fila/columna sin estorbos) CARGA hacia ti )
( vision: rayos desde el heroe en las 4 direcciones, frenados por Blocker y sabuesos )
RIGHT [ MOVING Player | no Blocker no Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | B_R ]
LEFT  [ MOVING Player | no Blocker no Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | B_L ]
UP    [ MOVING Player | no Blocker no Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | B_U ]
DOWN  [ MOVING Player | no Blocker no Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | B_D ]
RIGHT [ B_R | no Blocker no Hound no Player ] -> [ B_R | B_R ]
LEFT  [ B_L | no Blocker no Hound no Player ] -> [ B_L | B_L ]
UP    [ B_U | no Blocker no Hound no Player ] -> [ B_U | B_U ]
DOWN  [ B_D | no Blocker no Hound no Player ] -> [ B_D | B_D ]
( carga: el rayo que viaja hacia el sabueso indica donde esta el heroe )
RIGHT [ B_R | Hound ] -> [ B_R | LEFT Hound ]
LEFT  [ B_L | Hound ] -> [ B_L | RIGHT Hound ]
UP    [ B_U | Hound ] -> [ B_U | DOWN Hound ]
DOWN  [ B_D | Hound ] -> [ B_D | UP Hound ]
( a bocajarro (adyacente) no hay rayo que valga: ataca directamente )
RIGHT [ MOVING Player | stationary Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | LEFT Hound ]
LEFT  [ MOVING Player | stationary Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | RIGHT Hound ]
UP    [ MOVING Player | stationary Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | DOWN Hound ]
DOWN  [ MOVING Player | stationary Hound ] -> [ MOVING Player | UP Hound ]
( patrulla (solo si no esta cargando) y rebote como el enemigo )
RIGHT [ HoundR | Obstacle ] -> [ HoundL | Obstacle ]
LEFT  [ HoundL | Obstacle ] -> [ HoundR | Obstacle ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ stationary HoundR ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ RIGHT HoundR ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ stationary HoundL ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ LEFT  HoundL ]
( muerde como el enemigo )
[ > Player | Hound ] -> [ | Hound ] sfx4
[ > Hound | Player ] -> [ Hound | ] sfx4

LEFT  [ EnemyL | HeavyBox ] -> [ EnemyR | HeavyBox ]
RIGHT [ HoundR | HeavyBox ] -> [ HoundL | HeavyBox ]

RIGHT [ TurtleR | HeavyBox ] -> [ TurtleL | HeavyBox ]

( CAJA TIMIDA: no se empuja, se ARREA: huye un paso cuando te le acercas )

LEFT  [ MOVING Player | ShyBox ] -> [ MOVING Player | LEFT  ShyBox ]
UP    [ MOVING Player | ShyBox ] -> [ MOVING Player | UP    ShyBox ]
DOWN  [ MOVING Player | ShyBox ] -> [ MOVING Player | DOWN  ShyBox ]

RIGHT [ > Player ] [ CloneV ] -> [ > Player ] [ RIGHT CloneV ]

( TORTUGA: patrulla LENTA (un paso de cada dos) y muerde como el enemigo )
RIGHT [ TurtleR | Obstacle ] -> [ TurtleL | Obstacle ]
LEFT  [ TurtleL | Obstacle ] -> [ TurtleR | Obstacle ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ stationary TurtleR no Ttick ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ RIGHT TurtleR RIGHT Ttick ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ stationary TurtleL no Ttick ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ LEFT  TurtleL LEFT  Ttick ]
[ MOVING Player ] [ stationary Turtle Ttick ] -> [ MOVING Player ] [ Turtle ]
[ > Player | Turtle ] -> [ | Turtle ] sfx4
[ > Turtle | Player ] -> [ Turtle | ] sfx4

( LLAVES Y CERRADURAS DE COLOR: recoger y atravesar la del color )
[ Player KeyRed ]  -> [ Player HasRed ] sfx0
[ Player KeyBlue ] -> [ Player HasBlue ] sfx0
[ Player KeyGreen ]  -> [ Player HasGreen ] sfx0
[ Player KeyYellow ] -> [ Player HasYellow ] sfx0
[ HasRed  > Player | LockRed ]  -> [ | HasRed  Player ]
[ HasBlue > Player | LockBlue ] -> [ | HasBlue Player ]
[ HasGreen  > Player | LockGreen ]  -> [ | HasGreen  Player ]
[ HasYellow > Player | LockYellow ] -> [ | HasYellow Player ]

( --- 3b. ZONAS MAGNÉTICAS (M8) --- )
( El campo cae en la PUNTA de la flecha, la misma casilla que clava 2a, como en so3x: )
( un portal al que apunta un iman no teletransporta; uno a su espalda, si. )
( M8 comparte capa con M4 y lo pisa en esa casilla: es inocuo, M4 ya actuo en 2a y 3 )
( y los chequeos late de M4 exigen un Slide que 2a ya borro a la caja clavada. )
UP    [ Magnet_U | no M8 ] -> [ Magnet_U | M8 ]
DOWN  [ Magnet_D | no M8 ] -> [ Magnet_D | M8 ]
LEFT  [ Magnet_L | no M8 ] -> [ Magnet_L | M8 ]
RIGHT [ Magnet_R | no M8 ] -> [ Magnet_R | M8 ]

( --- 15e. PUERTAS LOGICAS AND / OR (ver prototipos/logica.txt) --- )
( Placa cubierta = hay un Presser encima. )

late [ AndBad ] -> [ ]

late [ NotDoorClosed ] -> [ NotDoorOpen ]
late [ NotOn ] [ NotDoorOpen no Presser ] -> [ NotOn ] [ NotDoorClosed ]

( NAND (AND normalmente ABIERTA): comparte la MISMA placa que la puerta AND de su color. )
( Reusa AndBad/AndBad2..5 (ya calculados arriba): placa cubierta -> AND abre y NAND cierra a la vez. )
( El guardia "no Presser" va en el CIERRE: nunca cierra sobre alguien parado en el vano. )

( --- NOVEDADES: TINAS DEL CAMALEON (el ultimo bano manda) --- )

late [ CamG TinaR ] -> [ CamR TinaR ]
late [ CamR TinaG ] -> [ CamG TinaG ]

( --- LLAVES: re-adherir el inventario al jugador (si se separo, vuelve; anti-muro) --- )
late [ HasRed  no Player ] [ Player no HasRed ]  -> [ ] [ Player HasRed ]
late [ HasBlue no Player ] [ Player no HasBlue ] -> [ ] [ Player HasBlue ]
late [ HasGreen  no Player ] [ Player no HasGreen ]  -> [ ] [ Player HasGreen ]
late [ HasYellow no Player ] [ Player no HasYellow ] -> [ ] [ Player HasYellow ]

( --- 18. EVALUACION DE VICTORIA --- )

( METAS en su PROPIO canal (BadM/NoWM), separado del canal de cajas (Bad/NoW): )
( asi la victoria admite DOS caminos alternativos (ver reglas de WinF abajo). )
late [ PlayerGoal no Player ] -> [ PlayerGoal BadM ]
late [ CloneGoal no AnyClone ] -> [ CloneGoal BadM ]

late [ Bad ] -> [ Bad NoW ]
late [ NoW | no NoW ] -> [ NoW | NoW ]
late [ BadM ] -> [ BadM NoWM ]
late [ NoWM | no NoWM ] -> [ NoWM | NoWM ]

late [ Player ] [ Odisea ] -> [ Player OdiS ] [ Odisea ]

( --- VICTORIA v2: el nivel se completa por CUALQUIERA de estos caminos --- )
( a. todo perfecto: cajas Y metas; tambien cubre niveles sin objetivos )
late [ Player no OdiS no NoW no NoWM ] -> [ Player WinF ]
( b. TODAS las cajas en sus dianas -solo si el nivel tiene dianas-, aunque falte la meta )
late [ Target ] [ Player no OdiS no NoW ] -> [ Target ] [ Player WinF ]
( c. TODAS las metas pisadas -solo si el nivel tiene metas-, aunque falten cajas )
late [ Meta ] [ Player no OdiS no NoWM ] -> [ Meta ] [ Player WinF ]
